summary: Okami entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Ōkami

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Okami HD on supported PC hardware at high resolution

primary.why: Okami HD is the current official high-resolution route, with Capcom documenting 4K support on supported PC hardware, PS4 Pro, and Xbox One X. PC gives the best capture/settings path for the HD remaster.
primary.how_to_play: Use Okami HD on PC. Record build, resolution, HD filter setting, input method, aspect/presentation settings, and whether PS2/Wii control differences are being compared.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record HD filter and input-control preferences, especially if comparing brush controls across PS2/Wii/Switch/PC.
